records.jp: ど、どうだった……？
records.en_original: Anything...?
records.en_auxiliary: Anything...?
records.en: D-did you find her...?

records.jp: ダメです……
records.en_original: Nothing...
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing...
records.en: No...

records.jp: 屋上から全部の教室を見て回ったけど、<CR>どこにもいない……
records.en_original: We looked all through the school, but she's nowhere to be found.
records.en_auxiliary: We looked all through the school, but she's nowhere to be found.
records.en: We searched the rooftop and every classroom,<CR>but she's nowhere...

records.jp: プールの方も……<CR>
records.en_original: She's not at the pool either...
records.en_auxiliary: She's not at the pool either...
records.en: The pool too...<CR>

records.jp: そんな……
records.en_original: No way...
records.en_auxiliary: No way...
records.en: No way...

records.jp: ダメだー、見つかんないよ……
records.en_original: Not a trace...
records.en_auxiliary: Not a trace...
records.en: No good. We can't find her...

records.jp: 外周をぐるっと回ってみたけど、<CR>痕跡すらなかったわ……
records.en_original: We looped around outside a few times, but couldn't find a thing.
records.en_auxiliary: We looped around outside a few times, but couldn't find a thing.
records.en: We made a full circuit around the school,<CR>but found no trace of her...

records.jp: ほ、本当に目の前で消えたんですか……？
records.en_original: D-did she really disappear right in front of your eyes...?
records.en_auxiliary: D-did she really disappear right in front of your eyes...?
records.en: D-did she really disappear right in front of your eyes...?

records.jp: う、うん……。今でも信じられないけど……
records.en_original: Y-yeah... Though it still seems unbelievable...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah... Though it still seems unbelievable...
records.en: Y-yeah... Though it still seems unbelievable...

records.jp: 記憶の話をしたら、動揺し始めて……
records.en_original: We were talking about her memories, and she started acting weird...
records.en_auxiliary: We were talking about her memories, and she started acting weird...
records.en: When we talked about her memories, she started getting upset...

records.jp: そのあと、突然消えちゃったんだよ……
records.en_original: Before we knew it, she was gone...
records.en_auxiliary: Before we knew it, she was gone...
records.en: Then she suddenly disappeared...

records.jp: ねえユズさん、こんなことってあるの……？
records.en_original: Yuzu, have you ever seen anything like this before?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, have you ever seen anything like this before?
records.en: Yuzu-san, have you ever seen anything like this before?

records.jp: いや、ない……と思うけど……。<CR>まさか私も知らない何かがある……？
records.en_original: No, I...don't think so. Could there be something that even I'm not aware of...?
records.en_auxiliary: No, I...don't think so. Could there be something that even I'm not aware of...?
records.en: No, I... don't think so.<CR>Could there be something even I don't know about...?

records.jp: 勇希ちゃん、大丈夫なのかな……？<CR>何か危ないことが起きてるんじゃ――
records.en_original: Will Yuki be okay? What if something bad happens to her—
records.en_auxiliary: Will Yuki be okay? What if something bad happens to her—
records.en: I wonder if Yuki-chan is all right...<CR>What if something dangerous has happened—

records.jp: そんな……
records.en_original: No...
records.en_auxiliary: No...
records.en: No...

records.jp: 勇希……
records.en_original: Yuki...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki...
records.en: Yuki...

records.jp: （……雰囲気が重い）
records.en_original: (Everyone is taking this really hard.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Everyone is taking this really hard.)
records.en: (The mood is so heavy.)

records.jp: （いつも明るい勇希がいないから……）
records.en_original: (Yuki is usually the one who cheers us up at times like this...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Yuki is usually the one who cheers us up at times like this...)
records.en: (Because the ever-cheerful Yuki isn't here...)

records.jp: ずっと出なかったココロトープが出てきた……。<CR>でも代わりに勇希が消えた……
records.en_original: Her Heartscape finally appears, but she's nowhere to be found...
records.en_auxiliary: Her Heartscape finally appears, but she's nowhere to be found...
records.en: The Heartscape that had never appeared finally did...<CR>but then Yuki disappeared...

records.jp: ……あのときの勇希ちゃん、<CR>「思い出したくなかった」って言って消えたのです
records.en_original: Yuki said she didn't want to remember right before she disappeared.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki said she didn't want to remember right before she disappeared.
records.en: At that moment, Yuki-chan said, 'I didn't want to remember,'<CR>and disappeared.

records.jp: 思い出したくなかった……？<CR>元の世界の記憶を、ってことですか……？
records.en_original: What could it be she doesn't want to remember? Her life in the real world?
records.en_auxiliary: What could it be she doesn't want to remember? Her life in the real world?
records.en: 'Didn't want to remember'...?<CR>Her memories of the original world...?

records.jp: 勇希自身も、なんでそう思っているのか<CR>分からないような様子だった……
records.en_original: Even Yuki didn't seem to know exactly why.
records.en_auxiliary: Even Yuki didn't seem to know exactly why.
records.en: Yuki herself didn't seem to understand<CR>why she felt that way...

records.jp: まるで、抑え込んでいた気持ちが溢れるみたいで――
records.en_original: Like feelings she had bottled up for a long time finally burst...
records.en_auxiliary: Like feelings she had bottled up for a long time finally burst...
records.en: It was as if feelings she'd kept suppressed suddenly overflowed—

records.jp: 抑え込んでいた、か……
records.en_original: Bottled up...
records.en_auxiliary: Bottled up...
records.en: Bottled up...

records.jp: 単純に、私は疑問だったの
records.en_original: I've thought it was strange from the start.
records.en_auxiliary: I've thought it was strange from the start.
records.en: I simply found it strange.

records.jp: 最初からこの世界にいるのに、<CR>なぜ記憶が戻っていないのか……って
records.en_original: That she hasn't recovered her memories despite being one of the people who has been here longest...
records.en_auxiliary: That she hasn't recovered her memories despite being one of the people who has been here longest...
records.en: Why hadn't she recovered her memories<CR>despite being here from the beginning...?

records.jp: そこに何か理由があるのかは、<CR>まだ見当もつかないけど……
records.en_original: Though if there's a reason for it, then I don't have the slightest idea...
records.en_auxiliary: Though if there's a reason for it, then I don't have the slightest idea...
records.en: I still have no idea<CR>whether there's a reason for that...

records.jp: ……私は、ここであれこれ考えてたって仕方ないと思う
records.en_original: I don't blame us for not being able to come up with anything.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't blame us for not being able to come up with anything.
records.en: ...I don't think there's any point in standing here thinking about it.

records.jp: だって、勇希の考えることなんて分かんないよ。<CR>ずっとそうだった……
records.en_original: I've never been able to tell what Yuki was thinking...
records.en_auxiliary: I've never been able to tell what Yuki was thinking...
records.en: I can't tell what Yuki is thinking.<CR>I've never been able to...

records.jp: だからもう、<CR>勇希のココロトープに行くしかないと思う
records.en_original: That's why I think we have no choice but to go to her Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I think we have no choice but to go to her Heartscape.
records.en: So I think we have no choice<CR>but to go into Yuki's Heartscape.

records.jp: あいつが何を考えているのか知るためには、<CR>それしかないから……
records.en_original: It's the only way we can learn what her true feelings are.
records.en_auxiliary: It's the only way we can learn what her true feelings are.
records.en: It's the only way<CR>to find out what she's thinking...

records.jp: ……それもそうね。どれだけ考えたって、<CR>それで勇希が帰ってくるわけじゃない
records.en_original: ...You may be right. Just sitting here thinking won't bring Yuki back.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You may be right. Just sitting here thinking won't bring Yuki back.
records.en: ...You're right. No matter how long we think about it,<CR>that won't bring Yuki back.

records.jp: ……たしかに、その通りだ。<CR>とにかく、行動に移そう
records.en_original: Agreed. We need to act.
records.en_auxiliary: Agreed. We need to act.
records.en: ...That's true.<CR>Let's take action.

records.jp: 勇希がいるとすれば、<CR>もうココロトープくらいしか考えられない……
records.en_original: Her Heartscape is the only place we haven't looked. If she's somewhere, it's gotta be there.
records.en_auxiliary: Her Heartscape is the only place we haven't looked. If she's somewhere, it's gotta be there.
records.en: If Yuki is anywhere,<CR>her Heartscape is the only possibility left...

records.jp: 大切な仲間なんだ。探しに行かなきゃ！
records.en_original: She's our friend. We have to find her!
records.en_auxiliary: She's our friend. We have to find her!
records.en: She's an important friend. We have to find her!

records.jp: うん。一秒でも早く勇希ちゃんを見つけないと……
records.en_original: Yeah. We should leave soon, every second counts.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. We should leave soon, every second counts.
records.en: Yes. We must find Yuki-chan as soon as possible...

records.jp: 私は、勇希の本当の想いを知りたい。<CR>みんなも……お願い。力を貸して
records.en_original: I want to know how Yuki feels. So please...lend me your support.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to know how Yuki feels. So please...lend me your support.
records.en: I want to know Yuki's true feelings.<CR>Everyone... please. Help me.
